finding.summary: 13184 measurement capsules in 8 signed batches, one RFC 6962 root over all. States per batch are published; the capsules themselves are held until the owner approves publication.

claim.statement: The capsule index is signed by the board key and its digest matches the served bytes.

test.procedure: for each batch: recompute every capsule_id and the batch Merkle root, check record sha256 and its board signature; then recompute index_root over the union of capsule ids; the index itself is signed (.signed.json) and OTS-stamped (.json.ots)
declared_failure_modes: Capsule ids and batch Merkle roots cannot be recomputed without the capsule bodies.

negative_control.description: Trailing byte, zeroed artifact digest, changed signature nibble.

result.reason: index signature verifies; the 13184 capsules it commits to are not public, so only the index, not its contents, was checked. private_until: owner approves publication.

limits: Not a grade, ranking, admission or approval of anything. The capsules measure declared vs observed; this index only binds them together.
A verified signature shows these bytes were signed by the named key. It does not show the content is true.
